content: Walk with the wise in the garden of discernment, and you will become wise without noticing.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Geleh khoshbooi dar hamam (گِل خوشبوی در حمام) — Saadi's Gulistan
explanation: Saadi famously recounts picking up a clump of clay in the bathhouse that smelled of exquisite perfume. He asked, 'Are you musk or ambergris?' The clay replied, 'I was only ordinary mud, but I sat beside the rose, and its perfume became mine.' Choose companions who elevate your fragrance.
practicalInsight: Spend time today reading a master thinker or speaking with an honorable friend. Let their fragrance soak into your clay.
reflectionPrompt: What kind of perfume—or stench—is the company you keep leaving on your character?
